metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the sermon, the bag, a list with half of it struck, and a book left under a cloth.

yesterday: Master Thwaite kept to the prodigal. Mistress Ansell called an hour and a half timely.
The gifts are four knots. Brooke stays. Holinshed stays under a cloth, and Gib has already chosen the cloth.
You said you would tell Anne her opinion of the forsworn gentlemen. The rest of it you said to the plaster.
The sixty shillings are still in the canvas.
